_doc: Crop-agnostic layers L1-L3 shared by every crop. Each node's `desc` is the option text Laya scores, so it describes what a farmer would SEE, with common Hindi/Hinglish words. Only L4 causes (kb/causes) are crop-specific; they attach to L3 syndromes via `syndromes` and are filtered by host crop.

unrelated.desc: the message is not about a plant, crop, field or farm problem (greeting, weather report, scheme, market price)

normal.desc: the plant is healthy or this is normal for its age and season; no damage, spots, pests or loss of growth (sab theek hai)

nodes.desc: insects, caterpillars, worms, eggs, holes, eaten leaves, spots, patches or lesions spreading, black or wet rotting patches, powder or mould on leaves, rust, blight, disease (keeda, sundi, illi, rog, dhabbe, phaphoond, jhulsa)
yellowing, pale, purple or striped leaves without insects or spots, poor growth, small grains or fruits, fertiliser and khad questions (urea, DAP, zinc, khaira)
too much or too little water, waterlogging, drought, drooping in heat, frost, cold, hail, storm, scorching, lodging (paani, sukha, pala, garmi, ole)

nodes.label_hi: दवा से नुकसान या खेती प्रबंधन
nodes.desc: damage after spraying weedicide or pesticide, burnt leaves after fertiliser, weeds, flowers or fruits dropping, small tubers, poor germination, wrong sowing (kharpatvar, dawa jalna)
visible insects, caterpillars, larvae, aphids, hoppers, whiteflies, mites, borers, frass or sawdust, holes, chewed or rolled leaves, dead central shoot
spots or lesions that grow, rings in spots, rust-coloured powder, white or grey mould, blight spreading in humid or rainy weather, rotting
water-soaked or greasy spots, yellow wavy edges from leaf tip, oozing, sudden wilting of green plants, foul-smelling rot
mosaic of light and dark green, curled or crinkled leaves, stunted bushy plants, often with whiteflies, aphids or thrips present
symptoms start on the older lower leaves: lower leaves yellow from the tip, purple lower leaves, scorched leaf edges, yellow between veins on old leaves

nodes.label_en: New-leaf deficiency (Zn, Fe, S, Ca, B)
nodes.desc: symptoms on the young upper leaves or growing tip: new leaves pale or white, rusty brown patches (khaira), striped young leaves, dying tips, fruit rot at the bottom
too much fertiliser: very dark lush leaves and lodging, or burnt brown leaf edges and tips after heavy fertiliser, salty water, white crust on soil
standing water, waterlogged field after heavy rain or over-irrigation, whole field turning yellow, roots brown and rotting
dry cracked soil, leaves rolling or drooping in the afternoon, missed irrigation, drought, wilting that recovers at night
very hot dry wind (loo), frost or cold night (pala), hail, storm, plants fallen over, sun-scorched patches on exposed side
damage appeared a few days after spraying weedicide, pesticide or a tank mix: burnt spots matching spray drift, twisted leaves, bleached leaves
flower or fruit drop, small fruits or tubers, poor germination, weeds, wrong spacing or sowing time, questions on how to increase yield
central shoot dried (dead heart), white empty earheads, holes in stem with sawdust, tunnels inside stem or fruit
leaves eaten with holes or ragged edges, caterpillars in the whorl, sawdust-like frass, leaves folded or rolled with larva inside, white scraped streaks
small insects sucking sap: aphids (mahu/chepa), hoppers, whiteflies, thrips, mites, bugs on grains; leaves curl, sticky honeydew, black sooty mould, hopper burn patches
plants cut at ground level at night, termites (deemak) hollowing roots, root grubs or weevils, patches of plants drying from the root
spots or long lesions on leaves that join up, brown or grey centres, target rings, leaves drying from spots (jhulsa)
yellow, orange or brown powder that rubs off on fingers (ratua), stripes of yellow pustules, white powdery coating, downy growth under leaves
stem or sheath rot, plants wilting and dying in patches, black powder replacing grains (smut), yellow-green balls on grains (false smut), rotten tubers or fruits
leaves drying from the tip with wavy yellow margin, water-soaked dark spots with yellow halo, milky ooze, sudden wilt
leaves curled upward or downward, crinkled, small, mosaic pattern, plant stunted and bushy, few fruits
older lower leaves turn uniformly pale yellow starting from the tip along the midrib, whole crop pale and slow, recovers after urea

nodes.label_en: Purpling, edge scorch or interveinal yellowing on old leaves
nodes.desc: older leaves purple or reddish, or leaf edges brown and scorched, or yellow between green veins on lower leaves, weak stems
new upper leaves yellow or white with green veins, broad white bands, rusty brown patches spreading in nursery or field (khaira), short internodes

nodes.label_hi: फल के निचले सिरे की सड़न
nodes.desc: black sunken rot at the bottom end of fruits, cracked fruits or stems, dying growing tips, hollow stems
very dark green soft growth and lodging, more pests, or leaf tips and edges burnt after heavy fertiliser, white salt crust
yellowing of the whole field or low patches after standing water, roots black, plants not growing, sour smell
leaves rolled like a pipe or drooping in the day, soil dry and cracked, grey-green colour, poor grain or fruit filling
leaves blackened or bleached after a cold night (pala), scorched by hot wind (loo), torn by hail, plants lodged by storm, flowers drying
bleached, twisted or burnt leaves appearing a few days after a spray, in a pattern following the spray path or near a neighbour's field
flowers or small fruits falling, tubers or fruits too small, poor fruit set, low yield questions
